description: Optional i18next (en/vi). Apps without this pack use English from configs/locales/en/*.json

messages: i18n is optional — English works without this pack via locale-fallback.
Loads every configs/locales/<lng>/*.json. Locale files for admin/auth/… come from those packs when already enabled.
Add admin later → `irwin add admin` brings vi/admin.json; or re-run `irwin add i18n --force` after enabling admin.
If en/common.json is empty: `irwin add auth --force` to refresh English auth strings.
Set default locale in configs/plugins/i18n.ts (lng / fallbackLng) if needed.
